title: Known odds, unknown odds
hook: Two stated cases: explore the expectation bounds left by ambiguous odds.

knows: Reading the stated arithmetic assumptions and a small numerical chart
doesNotKnow: How the expectation bounds left by ambiguous odds affects the stated comparison

misconception: The headline alone determines Lower, regardless of the stated inputs.
objective: Compare the expectation bounds left by ambiguous odds in two explicit finite cases; separate model arithmetic from an empirical population claim.
keyState: Both question and changed cases computed; both parameter/result witnesses retained.
